native_mechanism_note: Native xfade=transition=hlslice; optional RGB-split pre-pass is decorative.
description: RGB-split + horizontal pixel shift + brief noise burst between clips. Digital horror aesthetic — 'the simulation is glitching'. More aggressive than static-noise-transition (which is purely analog VHS noise).
audio_recipe: acrossfade 0.3s on base + optional bit-crushed glitch SFX (drone-tension.mp3 with chorus + bitcrush effect) at volume 0.40, peak at glitch_start + 0.1s.
audio_processing_hint: For full glitch effect, pre-process drone-tension.mp3 with ffmpeg -af 'chorus=0.7:0.9:55:0.4:0.25:2,aresample=8000,aresample=44100' to bitcrush.
use_cases: Liminal-space transition with 'something is broken' cue
Memory corruption with technological flavor (vs. VHS = analog)
avoid_for: More than 2x per reel — exhausts impact
hyperframes_alternative: CSS+GSAP: tween `filter:hue-rotate(0deg) → hue-rotate(45deg)` + `transform:translate(0,0) → translate(8px,-4px)` over 0.3s; or use canvas RGB-channel split with requestAnimationFrame.
canonical_observations: Not observed as INTER-CLIP transition in 8 canonical refs. IMPORTANT distinction: refs ref-08, ref-10, ref-11, ref-12 all show glitch/flicker effect — but EXCLUSIVELY applied to caption text overlay (e.g., ref-10 'caption rojo glitch HAY ALGO QUE ENZO', ref-12 'caption rojo pixel + flicker', ref-08 'flicker/glitch effect en texto rojo'), NOT as inter-clip transitions. F1 canonical horror-choice does not use digital RGB-split glitches between clips — that aesthetic belongs to cyberpunk/found-footage sub-genres outside the F1 set. Caption-level glitch effect should be implemented separately as a text-overlay effect, not via this inter-clip transition.
validated_notes: 0/8 F1 canonical inter-clip observations. Caption-level glitch (separate effect class) is present in 4/8 refs but does NOT validate this transition. Keep available for digital-horror/cyberpunk sub-genres with explicit SPEC justification. Consider splitting into 'caption-glitch-text' effect (validated in 4/8) and 'inter-clip-glitch-transition' (0/8) as separate library items.
